## Before you submit

Please search [existing issues](https://github.com/getdictus/dictus-desktop/issues) and [Discussions](https://github.com/getdictus/dictus-desktop/discussions) — someone may have asked already, and adding to an existing thread carries more weight than a new one.

If your idea is still vague, or you want to think it through with other users first, open a [Discussion](https://github.com/getdictus/dictus-desktop/discussions) instead. This template is for requests you can already describe concretely.

## The problem

<!--
What are you trying to do that Dictus makes hard or impossible today?

Describe the situation, not the solution. "I dictate in French but my code
identifiers are English, and every transcription mangles them" tells us far
more than "add a custom vocabulary feature".
-->

## Proposed solution

<!-- What you would like Dictus to do. Rough is fine. -->

## Alternatives you have considered

<!-- Other ways to solve it, including workarounds you currently use or other tools that get it right. -->

## Platforms

<!-- Which platforms does this concern? macOS, Windows, Linux, or all of them. -->

## Does it require a network connection?

<!--
Dictus processes speech entirely on-device and that is deliberate, not
incidental. Features that would send audio or text to a remote service face a
much higher bar, and when we do support them they stay opt-in and off by
default.

If your request needs a network call, say so and explain why it cannot work
locally. It does not disqualify the idea — it just changes the conversation.
-->

## Would you be willing to help implement it?

<!-- Entirely optional, and a "no" costs nothing. It just helps us plan. -->
